title: Search Code
description: Search for patterns in source code files using ripgrep with context

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern to search for

directory.description: Directory path to search in (defaults to current directory)

file_types.description: File types to include in search (e.g., ['rust', 'python', 'javascript'])

context_lines.description: Number of context lines to include around matches

case_sensitive.description: Whether the search should be case sensitive

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return
